common.question: Is the robot in a safe, collision-free position?
Is the robot’s gripper or end-effector intact and operational?
Is the perception/sensor system providing reliable data?
Is the scene free of unexpected hazards or obstacles?
Is the drawer handle clearly visible to the robot's sensors?
Is the drawer handle within the robot's reachable workspace?
Is the drawer handle unobstructed and accessible to the gripper?
Is the handle in a state that allows grasping (not broken or missing)?
Is there sufficient space in front of the drawer to allow it to open fully?
Is the area surrounding the drawer free from obstructions that would block opening?
Is the drawer mounted stably and able to move freely along its intended path?
Has the drawer not been pulled out so far that it cannot be pushed back in?
Are all drawers still properly inserted in the cabinet, with none pulled out so far that they cannot be normally closed?

success_detection.question: Is the drawer open far enough that the interior of the drawer is clearly visible?

task_specific.question: Based on the object detection status provided, is the drawer's AprilTag successfully detected by the robot's perception system?
Based on the object detection status provided, is the drawer rotation angle less than 15 degrees from front-facing?
